writer: shared scorer job (jobs/brain-scores/score_brains.py) via the existing score write path

activation.note: Set ACTIVE + approvedBy only with explicit owner authorisation for production score publication; takes effect when the orchestrator image containing this commit is deployed (a second, separate approval).

referenceCaseReview.note: Each needs {decision: APPROVED|REJECTED, reviewer, reviewedAt}. Decisions are recorded by a human reviewer; the case texts live in the private research workspace (analysis/capability-v2/reference_cases_proposed.json).

rollback: set status INACTIVE (next scorer run stops attaching) and delete /scores/biological-state/capability through the same writer, or redeploy the previous orchestrator image; the maturity block is never touched by this feature.
